answer: We formulate a mechanism requiring dynamic opportunity-cost bonds where agents deposit staking collateral into a decentralized liquidity garden. Through subgame-perfect punishment matrices and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, any inlet of malicious capital faces aggressive slashing penalties that ensure a strictly negative expected attack utility. This security barrier, as unyielding as a walnut, guarantees convergence to a robust Nash equilibrium by making Sybil multiplication cost-prohibitive.
